name: prompt-upgrade
description: Turns a rough prompt into a clear one right in the chat: a few multiple-choice questions, like plan mode, then the upgraded prompt is sent for you.

questionModel.title: Model that writes the questions
questionModel.description: Model alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id. A fast model is enough.

rewriteModel.title: Model that writes the upgraded prompt
rewriteModel.description: Model alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id.

maxQuestions.title: Most questions asked
maxQuestions.description: At most this many questions in the dialog (fewer, or none, when the prompt is already clear).

review.title: Review before sending
review.description: send: the upgraded prompt is sent at once. review: one last dialog shows it, to send, edit or send your original instead.
